title: VWAP
goal: Learn the average price of the day.

objectives.text: Know that VWAP starts over each day.
Know that VWAP is for intraday charts.
Say if price is over VWAP.
Know that VWAP is not a promise.

slides.text: VWAP is the average price of the day. Prices with more volume count more.
slides.title: The day's average

slides.text: VWAP starts fresh each day. Each day gets a new VWAP line.
slides.title: A fresh start

demo.caption: Made-up practice prices. VWAP starts over on day two.

slides.text: VWAP is for intraday charts. A daily chart has no VWAP.
slides.title: Only for one day

slides.text: Price over VWAP means it is up on the day's average. Price under VWAP means it is down.
slides.title: What it tries to tell you

demo.caption: Made-up practice prices. Watch price cross the VWAP line.

slides.text: VWAP is an average of the past. It cannot say what comes next. Do not trust it alone.
slides.title: Not a promise

options.text: The top price of the day
The average price of the day

questions.explanation: VWAP is the average price of the day. Busy times count more.
Yes. Each day gets its own VWAP line.
VWAP is for intraday charts, like the 5m chart.

questions.prompt: Price over VWAP means it is up on the day's average.
questions.explanation: Yes. Over the line is up on the average. Under the line is down.

questions.prompt: Price is under VWAP. What is true?

options.text: It is up on the average
It is down on the day's average

questions.explanation: Under VWAP means price is low for the day.

questions.prompt: VWAP tells you what the price will do next.
questions.explanation: No. VWAP is an average of the past.

questions.prompt: Turn on VWAP. Keep the rest off.
questions.explanation: VWAP shows as one line. It starts over on each new day.
